description: The source report assembles technical, geotechnical, regulatory and socioeconomic information for selecting and assessing pit thermal-storage sites. It draws on European project cases and workshops and explicitly records performance indicators, data requirements and modelling tools relevant to pre-feasibility assessment. This is a planning and simulation reference source. It does not establish executable model releases or enumerate original site data in native metadata. Regulatory and tender statements are historical report contents, not independently verified current guidance. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
